question: I think that if incanting a spell causes magic to activate, then it wouldn’t be impossible to discover new magic by putting appropriate-seeming words one after another, followed by constructing an appropriate-seeming mental image. Is there anyone who activates magic and discovers magic like this?
answer: In short, the thing that causes a mental image to take form is called an ‘incantation’, so even while chanting the fire incantation ‘Goa’, if the person chanting thinks of it as a ‘wind’ incantation, wind magic will be activated. It might be difficult to say ‘Goa’ and actually get ‘Fuura’ magic.
